card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.

mechanism: A assigns an unwanted bin duty by applying the rota and the limited duration of a swap B requested.
confusable: Unlike personal favor trading, A makes the recorded rule itself the source of B's obligation.
comparison: A mutual swap clause returns Tuesday to B; the president scene turns B's own cost-saving vote into inherited cleaning.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
